description: This file implements a service class for interacting with the Fireworks AI platform using an OpenAI-compatible interface. It extends existing OpenAILLMService to specify Fireworks-specific API endpoint and parameters, providing methods for creating clients and building chat completion parameters.

classes.name: FireworksLLMService
classes.description: A subclass of OpenAILLMService configured to interact with Fireworks AI API, providing custom initialization and parameter building for chat completions.

methods.name: create_client(self, api_key=None, base_url=None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates and returns a Fireworks-compatible OpenAI client instance with the specified API key and base URL.

methods.name: dict build_chat_completion_params(self, params_from_context: OpenAILLMInvocationParams)
methods.description: Constructs the parameter dictionary for a chat completion request, tailored for Fireworks API by excluding unsupported parameters and including relevant settings.
